source.inspectionScope: Fresh full66-line patch read. Exact corrected key and local ordering inspected. Fixed collector/general list and actual preference default checked; existing exact schema/reporting snapshots reused. No telemetry collection or upload.

commit 1b1f02222072c4de74eb27382978fd068b04546a
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Apr 8 22:07:06 2025 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Tue Apr 8 22:07:06 2025 +1200

    Bug 1959075 - Record mailnews.scroll_to_new_message correctly. r=freaktechnik
    And while we're here, let's fix some poor alphabetising.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D244731

diff --git a/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs b/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
index 985d4ca7c7b..ddf9b27ff76 100644
--- a/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
+++ b/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
@@ -1294,26 +1294,26 @@ function reportPreferences() {
   const booleanPrefs = [
     // General
     "browser.cache.disk.smart_size.enabled",
-    "privacy.clearOnShutdown.cache",
     "general.autoScroll",
     "general.smoothScroll",
     "intl.regional_prefs.use_os_locales",
     "layers.acceleration.disabled",
     "mail.biff.play_sound",
     "mail.close_message_window.on_delete",
+    "mail.dark-reader.enabled",
+    "mail.dark-reader.show-toggle",
     "mail.delete_matches_sort_order",
     "mail.display_glyph",
-    "mail.mailnews.scroll_to_new_message",
     "mail.prompt_purge_threshold",
     "mail.purge.ask",
     "mail.showCondensedAddresses",
     "mail.threadpane.table.horizontal_scroll",
-    "mail.dark-reader.enabled",
-    "mail.dark-reader.show-toggle",
     "mailnews.database.global.indexer.enabled",
     "mailnews.mark_message_read.auto",
     "mailnews.mark_message_read.delay",
+    "mailnews.scroll_to_new_message",
     "mailnews.start_page.enabled",
+    "privacy.clearOnShutdown.cache",
     "searchintegration.enable",
 
     // Fonts
diff --git a/mail/metrics.yaml b/mail/metrics.yaml
index 1aac62edc55..3e56c2ed04b 100644
--- a/mail/metrics.yaml
+++ b/mail/metrics.yaml
@@ -211,7 +211,6 @@ mail:
       - mail.enable_autocomplete
       - mail.fixed_width_messages
       - mail.forward_add_extension
-      - mail.mailnews.scroll_to_new_message
       - mail.mdn.report.enabled
       - mail.minimizeToTray
       - mail.operate_on_msgs_in_collapsed_threads
@@ -234,6 +233,7 @@ mail:
       - mailnews.mark_message_read.auto
       - mailnews.mark_message_read.delay
       - mailnews.message_display.disable_remote_image
+      - mailnews.scroll_to_new_message
       - mailnews.sendformat.auto_downgrade
       - mailnews.start_page.enabled
       - messenger.options.getAttentionOnNewMessages
